messages:
maria: Heads-up — during the scheduled customer BYOK rotation test we saw the HSM import step fail for customer `acct-788` (error: slot not found). I want to run a quick escalation/rotation checklist so we capture audit evidence for compliance.

sam: oncall here. Can you paste the exact error from the import job and whether this is blocking live traffic? :eyes:

maria: Paste: `ERROR: HSM_IMPORT_FAILED: slot_not_found (slot=3) trace=0x7f8b)` — It's a test key rotation, not blocking production inference because that tenant is routed to fallback CMK for serving. But we need to treat as potential custody boundary violation if the import couldn't be completed.

jake: I can pull the HSM operator logs and the keystore audit trail. I'm going to run the preliminary audit query. Will also check RBAC change that was applied earlier today (temp grant for vendor operator).

maria: steps I think we need: 1) collect HSM import logs + keystore change logs, 2) snapshot RBAC grants and who approved, 3) freeze any further rotations for that tenant, 4) notify compliance/legal if provenance gap. Thoughts?

sam: +1. I'll open an incident shorthand and set severity=low (no customer impact) but mark compliance-review required.

nehra: If there is any gap in custody (key material not safely imported) we need chain-of-custody evidence for the customer and regulators. Include signed attestations, operator IDs, and the approval ticket.

maria: copying what I grabbed from the import pod output and HSM proxy: ```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z import_job[id=rp-224]: starting
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z hsm-proxy[slot=3]: ERROR slot_not_found
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z import_job[id=rp-224]: aborting, status=FAILED
```

jake: audit query I'm running against our central ES: ```
GET /keystore-logs/_search
{ "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "term": { "tenant_id": "acct-788" }}, { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "now-1d/d" }}} ] } } }
```

sam: Also confirm who had the temporary RBAC grant today: we gave `hsm-importer` role to `vendor-ops` at 08:30. Who approved?

jake: Approver was `maria` (approval ticket #INC-1142) — I see the grant audit event: `rbac_change: {granted_to: vendor-ops, role: hsm-importer, actor: maria, ticket: INC-1142}` in logs.

maria: I approved because vendor was doing test import. I also documented the escrow handshake in the ticket but didn't expect the slot mismatch.

nehra: Good that approval exists. For evidence bundle include: ticket, signed approval, operator session IDs, hsm import logs, keystore event stream, and the rollback/mitigation steps. We might need a temporary attestation to the customer.

sam: Mitigation plan: 1) stop further import attempts, 2) retry import on a different slot after operator verifies HSM firmware mapping, 3) if retry fails, roll back to customer CMK and schedule an in-person escrow/unlock with vendor per contract. I'll set a follow-up with infra.

jake: I'll also check KMS integration: ensure that the fallback CMK keys have their key IDs and wrapping logs, and snapshot KMS access tokens issued during the window. Query for wrap/unwrap events: ```
GET /kms-events/_search?q=event:(WrapKey OR UnwrapKey) AND tenant:acct-788&size=100
```

maria: We should record the time window to show no plaintext key material left the boundary. From logs we have no export call documented; only local import attempt.

audit-bot: Automated note: 'keystore-snapshot' artifact created at s3://redwood-audit/artifacts/1738204567-acct-788-rotation.tar.gz by jake.

nehra: Please also redact any operator PII in the shared bundle; include hashed session IDs. Legal will prepare a short customer-facing statement if asked.

maria: I'll prepare the evidence bundle and upload to the compliance bucket after redaction. Sam — can you escalate to infra vendor contact for an urgent HSM slot map check?

sam: Doing it now, pinging @vendor-ops and @infra-leads. Also creating an incident runbook entry with the RBAC rollback process.

jake: Quick RBAC rollback snippet if needed (for runbook): ```bash
# revoke temporary role
rbacctl revoke --actor maria --target vendor-ops --role hsm-importer --ticket INC-1142
# snapshot current grants
rbacctl list --tenant acct-788 --out /tmp/acct-788-grants.json
```

maria: Final ask: keep all communication in this thread for the audit trail. I'll mark the ticket with compliance required and upload the artifact. If vendor confirms slot remap caused a virtual slot mismatch, we can re-run with operator present and recording.

sam: copied. tagging as `compliance-review` and setting follow-up in 4 hours. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — I'll post the artifact link once uploaded and close if retry succeeds.
